notes: The opening date is only given as January 2027; the first of the month in the data is a placeholder. Contact CCM Prep at 513-556-2595 or ccmprep@uc.edu.
name: CCM Prep Ballet Intensive
org: University of Cincinnati College-Conservatory of Music (CCM Prep)
what_you_do: A one week summer ballet program. You work on ballet skills, pointe and modern dance. You also take classes on avoiding injury, healthy eating and pilates.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 17. Advanced dancers who have at least two full years on pointe. No audition.
deadline_text: Registration opens in January 2027. A closing date is not stated on the page.
how_to_apply: Sign up online when it opens. Use the Learn more link for the Ballet Intensive on the CCM Prep teen programs page.
